messages:
maria: PR up for review — optkit docs: add kv-prefetch example, small quant-profile migration note, and fix broken link from /optimize/guide -> /optimize/toolkit. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3456

devon: sgtm. which directory did you put the snippet?

maria: docs/optimize/toolkit/examples/sdk-snippets.md (new section 'kv-prefetch and quant profiles')

lee: heads up, I hit 404 on the guide link in the current doc (line 42). I'll add redirect in site config if needed.

kate: can we include a minimal runnable SDK snippet? i'd like to paste to console and run quick smoke test.

maria: added this example:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${{REDWOOD_API_KEY}}")
resp = client.generate(
  model="redwood/opt-small-v1",
  prompt="Summarize: ...",
  batching={"enabled": True, "max_batch_size": 8},
  caching={"kv_prefetch": True},
  quant_profile="safe-8bit",
  stream=False,
)
print(resp.text)
```

sanjay: two nit: quant_profile should be quoted and we should call out that 'safe-8bit' requires model with quantization support. Also add note about latency tradeoffs when kv_prefetch is on.

maria: added both notes in the PR description. see checklist:
- add example header
- add migration note (old quant -> profile)
- add warning about latency
- fix link

docs-bot: PR #3456 opened by maria -> reviewers: devon, lee, sanjay\n
devon: I'll do a quick pass on examples and links today. If OK, can we merge before EOD?

maria: EOD works. @lee can you add redirect if needed? :pray:

lee: will do. created issue #789 to track redirect.

kate: quick QA steps I ran locally:
- pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
- docker-compose up -d (local mkdocs)
- open http://localhost:8000/optimize/toolkit/examples/sdk-snippets.html
- run the snippet with env var REDWOOD_API_KEY set

aqa-bot: smoke test results: snippet executed, response latency 320ms, token cost 0.02
maria: thanks all. leaving open for any last comments before merge.

sanjay: left one inline comment re: batch size suggestion, otherwise LGTM :thumbsup:

maria: merging in 10 if no objections.

(10 minutes later)
maria: merged. link fix verified live: /optimize/toolkit now points correctly. :tada:

lee: redirect issue #789 closed.
